heading: மொழிபெயர்ப்பு
lines: O Chief of a lofty mountain,
The swift flowing stream is in spate
And it evokes panic; the real colour
Of the water is concealed by the floating flowers;
There are whirlpools caused by the water
That rises above and falls down
After striking against the rocks
Which serve as beds to the sleeping crocodiles;
The current of the stream pulls with force,
A wild tusker, exhausting all its strength;
Even folks accustomed to this place
Will slip all of a sudden
Even in the paths free from hazards;
Suppose one day, something untoward happens to you,
My friend will cease to be
The very next day;
We are assailed by a maddening grief
On account of your nightly visits;
Would anybody dare to come to this place
During this midnight, ascending the river banks
Difficult to reach, after swimming fearless
The flood, like a wild tusker
Of wrathful eyes?
You can embrace her shoulders—
Which my beloved mother fostered with care--,
Which are broad and soft like the curved part
Between two successive nodes of the bamboo
On the extended hill full of shrubs
Rich in the comely blooms of kantal
In the thick woods full of swinging fruits
In the long hill-range of high peaks
Rich in curved honey-combs
Near our house,
Even if you come by day!
